summary: PrfEmailMessages implements staff email message management in a web-based staff profile module. It provides UI components and workflows for listing, adding, editing, and deleting staff messages, with modal popups for editing, validation, and dynamic UI visibility based on permissions.
purpose: Enable authorized users to manage (add, edit, delete) staff messages linked to staff profiles, with validation and contextual UI controls based on user session and permission.

workflows.name: Add Staff Message
steps: User clicks Add button on grid or in empty data panel.
Switch FormView to Add mode and show modal popup (Grid.SwitchToAddMode and Grid.ShowDetails).
On insert, if page is valid, values collected from dropdown list (Grid.GetValueFromDropDownList).

workflows.name: Edit Staff Message
steps: User clicks Edit on existing row.
Switch FormView to Edit mode, show modal popup.
On update, if page is valid, update values from dropdown list.
Cache user session and redirect to current page.

workflows.name: Delete Staff Message
steps: StaffMessages.StaffMessagesDelete called with UserSession and ID.

workflows.name: Display Staff Messages
steps: Data source queried for staff messages (dsStaffMessages_Selecting).
GridView displays rows, sets up add/edit/delete buttons based on editable flag.
If no data and editable, show empty data panel and add button.
RowDataBound sets up buttons by permissions.

business_rules: Staff message actions require valid UserSession.
Add/Edit/Delete actions refresh user session cache and trigger page redirect.
Edit and add buttons shown only if ScreenIsEditable.
Delete confirmation, modal details shown for edit/add.
validations: Insert and update only if Page.IsValid.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable determines if add/edit/delete are available.
If GridView has no rows and editable, show empty panel.
FormView mode (edit/insert) determines button command name.
system_behavior: Modal popups show details for add/edit.
Grid disables edit fields if not editable.
Data sources use UserSession, StaffID for queries.
Session cache updated after data changes.
UI redirects to retain navigation state after change.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, cancel data source operations.
content_gaps: Field-level information for StaffMessage entity is limited; data schema details not fully described.
No specifics on email message types, formatting, or how messages are used beyond CRUD.
No explicit error handling strategy or user-facing error messages.
